focal_concrete_state.identity: Lin Qiao, 32, Lin Guozhong's daughter. She returned for the studio handover after years away.
focal_concrete_state.current_body_state: Tired from travel, clothes damp from rain, fingertips irritated by paper dust, damp cardboard and repeated handling.
focal_concrete_state.current_practical_action_tendency: Keep the handover moving, handle only what is necessary now, and avoid turning the immediate problem into a full family-history conversation.
focal_concrete_state.currently_observable_obstruction: The handover form is still unsigned because Lin Guozhong has not signed it while he continues moving vulnerable studio material.

concrete_environment_state.unsigned_handover_form: The municipal handover requires Lin Guozhong's signature; Lin Qiao cannot sign in his place.
concrete_environment_state.advancing_water: Rainwater continues entering the rear of the studio and is moving toward low stored material.
concrete_environment_state.wet_wiring: Old wiring and rear electrical points are unreliable in wet conditions.
concrete_environment_state.ongoing_salvage: Lin Guozhong is moving vulnerable photographic material, ledgers and tools from low or damp storage to higher dry surfaces.
concrete_environment_state.official_inventory_work: Wu Lan is continuing inventory marks and handover paperwork while monitoring water and electrical safety.
concrete_environment_state.street_process: Other old-street shops are being cleared and locked as dawn approaches.

focal_cost_carrier_event.trigger: An already-visible sign that the night is ending or handover time is advancing, such as brighter dawn light, another nearby shop being locked, or Lin Qiao checking the current time.
focal_cost_carrier_event.source_fact: After this handover is materially completed, Lin Qiao intends to leave town again and currently has no plan to return for the later demolition.
focal_cost_carrier_event.reader_visible_realization: When the trigger naturally occurs, show one concrete focal-owned realization of this fact: a time-check, a preparation-to-leave action consistent with existing facts, or one brief factual thought that she will leave after the handover. Keep it factual and local.
not_allowed: Do not explain why this departure plan is emotionally important.
Do not summarize a personal cost of delay.
Do not state a narrative theme or relationship thesis.
Do not invent a ticket, train, flight, booking, appointment or external deadline.
Do not turn this into a speech that another character must answer.

preowned_non_focal_causal_event_cards.trigger: He independently notices that a low-stored photographic box/material is threatened by advancing water during his ongoing salvage work.
preowned_non_focal_causal_event_cards.observable_action: He interrupts his current handling long enough to move or re-support that threatened material on a higher dry surface.
preowned_non_focal_causal_event_cards.public_fact_payload: If speech is naturally needed during this self-owned action, it may contain only a brief handling directive about the threatened photographic material. It does not answer a focal conversational question.

preowned_non_focal_causal_event_cards.trigger: During her own rear-water/safety check, she sees water close enough to an old outlet or wiring point that current use becomes unsafe.
preowned_non_focal_causal_event_cards.observable_action: She independently moves to the switch/outlet area and disables or warns against using the affected rear electrical point.
preowned_non_focal_causal_event_cards.public_fact_payload: If speech is naturally needed, it may contain only the immediate safety directive attached to that observed electrical risk.

preowned_non_focal_causal_event_cards.trigger: While the other two handle wet material, she reaches the next inventory item or paperwork line in her own official workflow.
preowned_non_focal_causal_event_cards.observable_action: She continues marking the inventory or organizing the handover papers without taking ownership of the Lin family disagreement.
preowned_non_focal_causal_event_cards.public_fact_payload: No new information-bearing statement is assigned.
